clearance.drive: R-clear's: D = c^n/(K^n + c^n), c = n_T/V

loop_band_rules.note: R-chain's rule, band = bound + max(rel max(|x|, floor scale), abs), at dt = 1 ms. The clamped arm's bands add the propagated F* allowance (loop_design.py).

loop.source: the FR-7 lane's export of the probe world, input values only, relayed by the lead: interface/loop_world_export.json
loop.synthetic: every value marked synthetic is this world's own synthetic choice (D217); the heredity cell H's declared values are the engine's fixture values, then scaled as stated

setting.note: D231 as the lead registered it: scale 100 (ions relax in about 50 s), phi = 1 (the units carry the cell's whole Na leak), the held precursor

cell.initial_note: state H scaled: where the steady-state settle begins, not the start

pump.fuel: maintained reservoirs (held pools), declared with the standard state

precursor.regime: held: a supply S_P and a fast first-order clearance k_P under D150's turnover, so n_P relaxes in about 1 s to S_P/(k_P + k_a F) and the units' sensitivity to F, k_P/(k_P + k_a F), is at least 0.987 at any F (0.9974 at the start)

route.target: the producer's assembly rate k_a (B1', target_half_steps), operating range [0, 1] of the state's fraction

regulator.with_the_template: both routes stand on the same element (the route naleak_units) of the producer's assembly rate, so the effective rate is k_a x F_T x F_loop, the product in declared order (the template's coupling first), each evaluated at the start of each of the producer's half-steps from the state that half-step receives

factor.factor: F_T = b + (1 - b) c^n/(K^n + c^n), c = n_T/V

scale.note: D233: F4's template scales its half-saturation K and its dose together, x5 (K 0.05 mM, dose 0.5 mM; n, the 20 s half-life, b_T 0.2 and epsilon unchanged). Only c/K drives the cell, so F_T(t), t_clear (260 s) and every non-template row are unchanged; the template's tail crosses D150's mean-field floor (10^2 molecules in 7.5 fL) at 289.3 s instead of 242.8 s, after the cut at t_d = 260 s, and clearance (D <= epsilon) comes at about 320 molecules, above the floor

arms.cut_control: the lead's accepted form: from t_d the loop's coupling is switched off (F_loop exactly 1) and the producer's scheduled k_a is stepped to k_a F*, F* the engine's own applied loop factor from the coupling's record at the closed arm's row t_d, at the same dt
arms.F_star_bound_note: |F*_engine - F*_reference| <= |ds/dt(t_d)| dt + the s band: a full step's lag (twice the half step the engine's applied factor can lag) plus the engine's allowed error in s
